Question: How many users had their first losing options trade this week?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM options_trades WHERE is_first_loss = TRUE AND close_date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) AND close_date < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '7 days'

Question: What is the Day-30 retention rate for users who had their first losing trade last month?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_rate_pct FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND cohort_week < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

Question: What is the Day-30 retention rate for users whose first loss was greater than 50% of their premium?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_rate_pct FROM interventions i JOIN options_trades t ON i.user_id = t.user_id AND t.is_first_loss = TRUE WHERE t.pnl_pct < -50

Question: Compare Day-30 retention across loss magnitude buckets: small (<20%)
ExpectedAnswer: medium (20-50%)
column4: SELECT CASE WHEN t.pnl_pct BETWEEN -20 AND 0 THEN 'Small (<20%)' WHEN t.pnl_pct BETWEEN -50 AND -20 THEN 'Medium (20-50%)' ELSE 'Large (>50%)' END AS loss_bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN options_trades t ON i.user_id = t.user_id AND t.is_first_loss = TRUE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

Question: Which intervention message framing has the highest Day-30 retention rate?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT message_framing, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions GROUP BY message_framing ORDER BY retention_pct DESC

Question: Does sending the intervention immediately vs next morning make a difference to retention?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT intervention_type, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions WHERE intervention_type IN ('IMMEDIATE', 'NEXT_MORNING') GROUP BY intervention_type

Question: Which feature suggestion in the post-loss message leads to the best retention?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT feature_suggested, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions GROUP BY feature_suggested ORDER BY retention_pct DESC

Question: Does showing a cooling-off prompt improve or hurt Day-30 retention?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT cooling_off_shown, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions GROUP BY cooling_off_shown

Question: What percentage of users who opened the intervention notification went on to trade again within 30 days?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL

Question: What percentage of users who did NOT open the intervention notification traded again within 30 days?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions WHERE opened_at IS NULL

Question: What is the average number of days between a user's first loss and their next trade?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(next_trade_date, DATE(sent_at))), 1) AS avg_days_to_next_trade FROM interventions WHERE next_trade_date IS NOT NULL

Question: How many users who had their first loss placed a second trade within 72 hours (revenge trading)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS revenge_traders FROM interventions WHERE next_trade_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(next_trade_date, DATE(sent_at)) <= 3

Question: What was the P&L outcome of the second trade for users who traded within 72 hours of their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t2.pnl_pct), 2) AS avg_pnl_pct, COUNT(*) AS users FROM interventions i JOIN options_trades t1 ON i.user_id = t1.user_id AND t1.is_first_loss = TRUE JOIN options_trades t2 ON i.user_id = t2.user_id AND t2.trade_date > t1.close_date AND t2.close_date IS NOT NULL WHERE i.next_trade_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(i.next_trade_date, DATE(i.sent_at)) <= 3 ORDER BY t2.trade_date LIMIT 1

Question: Which features did retained users use in the 7 days after their first loss that churned users did not?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT f.feature_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN f.user_id END) AS retained_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = FALSE THEN f.user_id END) AS churned_users FROM interventions i JOIN feature_usage f ON i.user_id = f.user_id AND f.used_at BETWEEN i.sent_at AND i.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.feature_name ORDER BY retained_users DESC

Question: How many users used the Greeks viewer within 7 days of their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) FROM interventions i JOIN feature_usage f ON i.user_id = f.user_id AND f.feature_name = 'GREEKS_VIEWER' AND f.used_at BETWEEN i.sent_at AND i.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days'

Question: What is the retention rate for users who used the payoff chart after their first loss vs those who did not?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT used_payoff_chart, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM (SELECT i.user_id, i.day30_retained, MAX(CASE WHEN f.feature_name = 'PAYOFF_CHART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS used_payoff_chart FROM interventions i LEFT JOIN feature_usage f ON i.user_id = f.user_id AND f.used_at BETWEEN i.sent_at AND i.sent_at + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY i.user_id, i.day30_retained) sub GROUP BY used_payoff_chart

Question: How many users opened the app at least once in the 72 hours after their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM interventions i JOIN user_sessions s ON i.user_id = s.user_id AND s.session_start BETWEEN i.sent_at AND i.sent_at + INTERVAL '3 days'

Question: What is the retention rate broken down by user city tier?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT u.city_tier, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.city_tier ORDER BY u.city_tier

Question: What is the retention rate for Tier 1 vs Tier 2 vs Tier 3 city users?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT CASE u.city_tier WHEN 1 THEN 'Tier 1 - Metro' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tier 2 - Mid-size' ELSE 'Tier 3 - Small town' END AS city_tier_label, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.city_tier ORDER BY u.city_tier

Question: Compare retention rates for users whose first loss was a naked position vs a spread strategy?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT t.strategy, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN options_trades t ON i.user_id = t.user_id AND t.is_first_loss = TRUE GROUP BY t.strategy ORDER BY retention_pct DESC

Question: What is the retention rate for CALL buyers vs PUT buyers on their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT t.option_type, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN options_trades t ON i.user_id = t.user_id AND t.is_first_loss = TRUE WHERE t.position_type = 'BUY' GROUP BY t.option_type

Question: Which symbols have the highest first-loss rate (most first trades that result in a loss)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) AS first_trades, SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_loss = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_losses, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_loss = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS first_loss_rate_pct FROM options_trades WHERE is_first_trade = TRUE AND close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY first_loss_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 10

Question: What percentage of first-trade users chose NIFTY vs BANKNIFTY vs individual stocks?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_first_trades FROM options_trades WHERE is_first_trade = TRUE GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY users DESC

Question: How many users in this week's cohort are eligible for intervention (minimum cohort size check)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 200 THEN 'SUFFICIENT - Run experiment' ELSE 'INSUFFICIENT - Hold experiment' END AS status FROM options_trades WHERE is_first_loss = TRUE AND close_date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)

Question: Show the experiment results summary for each cohort week in the last 3 months
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT cohort_week, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct, MAX(message_framing) AS winning_framing FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week DESC

Question: Which cohort week had the best Day-30 retention rate?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT cohort_week, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY retention_pct DESC LIMIT 1

Question: What was the intervention combination (framing + timing + feature) used in the best-performing cohort week?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT cohort_week, message_framing, intervention_type, feature_suggested, cooling_off_shown, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions GROUP BY cohort_week, message_framing, intervention_type, feature_suggested, cooling_off_shown ORDER BY retention_pct DESC LIMIT 5

Question: Which users had a first loss but received no intervention (control group)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS control_group_size FROM options_trades t LEFT JOIN interventions i ON t.user_id = i.user_id WHERE t.is_first_loss = TRUE AND i.user_id IS NULL

Question: What is the baseline Day-30 retention rate with no intervention (control group)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t2.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.user_id), 2) AS baseline_retention_pct FROM options_trades t1 LEFT JOIN interventions i ON t1.user_id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN options_trades t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id AND t2.trade_date > t1.close_date AND t2.trade_date <= t1.close_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE t1.is_first_loss = TRUE AND i.user_id IS NULL AND t1.close_date IS NOT NULL

Question: How many users who set an alert on a symbol never actually traded that symbol?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN options_trades t ON a.user_id = t.user_id AND t.symbol = a.symbol WHERE t.trade_id IS NULL AND a.triggered_at IS NOT NULL

Question: What percentage of alerts that triggered led to an actual trade within 1 hour?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN trade_placed_after = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct FROM alerts WHERE triggered_at IS NOT NULL

Question: How many retained users used paper trading mode after their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) FROM interventions i JOIN feature_usage f ON i.user_id = f.user_id AND f.feature_name = 'PAPER_TRADING' AND f.used_at BETWEEN i.sent_at AND i.sent_at + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE i.day30_retained = TRUE

Question: What is the average days-to-expiry at which users enter their first losing trade?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_to_expiry), 1) AS avg_dte FROM options_trades WHERE is_first_loss = TRUE

Question: Show me users who churned after first loss (not retained) but are still opening the app passively
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS passive_churned_users FROM interventions i JOIN user_sessions s ON i.user_id = s.user_id AND s.session_date > DATE(i.sent_at) + 30 WHERE i.day30_retained = FALSE

Question: What is the retention rate split by user platform (app vs web)?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT u.platform, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions i JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.platform

Question: List the top 10 users by total premium lost across all trades in the last 90 days
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT user_id, ROUND(SUM(ABS(realized_pnl)), 2) AS total_loss_inr, COUNT(*) AS total_trades FROM options_trades WHERE realized_pnl < 0 AND close_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total_loss_inr DESC LIMIT 10

Question: How many users graduated from naked positions to using spreads after their first loss?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.user_id) FROM options_trades t1 JOIN options_trades t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id AND t2.trade_date > t1.close_date WHERE t1.is_first_loss = TRUE AND t1.strategy = 'NAKED' AND t2.strategy IN ('SPREAD', 'IRON_CONDOR', 'STRADDLE', 'STRANGLE')

Question: What is the week-over-week trend in first-loss Day-30 retention over the last 12 weeks?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT cohort_week, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 weeks' GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week

Question: Which experiment variant should we run next week based on last 4 weeks of data?
ExpectedAnswer: SELECT message_framing, intervention_type, feature_suggested, cooling_off_shown, COUNT(*) AS total_users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4 weeks' GROUP BY message_framing, intervention_type, feature_suggested, cooling_off_shown ORDER BY retention_pct DESC LIMIT 3

Question: Give me a full experiment dashboard: cohort size
ExpectedAnswer: retention by framing
column5: and overall this week vs last week
column6: SELECT 'This week' AS period, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS overall_retention FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week = DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 'Last week', COUNT(*), ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN day30_retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM interventions WHERE cohort_week = DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 week'
